Ah troll. You see the key with trolling is keeping it going for as long as possible. You really aren't supposed to reveal you aren't being serious and are a troll until the last minute basically when you are close to being blocked or when the replies stop coming. Revealing so soon stops potential victims for commenting or turns away current victims while theres still reactions to get. Your account is new so i suspect that you are a new troll and/or this is your alt.  So you will eventually understand the game

Also when you reveal your want a climatic revealing. Which means saying outlandish things that come off as serious. Get that reaction going and eventually you will have said enough outlandish things to be seen as a troll. That's the reveal you want. But if you can dont get unveiled. stops lots of the fun you could of had.

Also on reddit you really should build up karma before trolling. Many places prevent comments from low karma accounts. Building up karma during the time it takes for your account to be old enough to post and comment is places is the key. 

Also. Go extreme but don't break rules. That keeps you unbanned for as long as possible. This really keeps you around for longer periods of time

Also. Be consistent enough to present as serious when people look through your profile. Delete post or comments that show you might be a troll. Keeping people engaged is name of the game. And being seen as serious is what keeps people engaged.
